messages:
Amelia: heads-up — noticed a spike in EU customer requests getting ejected to APAC variant and then re-ejected back to EU. looks like a repeated reroute within ~2s causing extra load on routing control plane. not a full circuit-breaker, but a thrash.
Diego: ugh. any logs or sample decisions?
Amelia: pasted an anonymized decision trace from routing-debug: 
```
{ decision_id: "d-9a3f", src_region: "eu-west-1", preferred_tier: "enterprise", selected_pool: "dedicated-eu-1", fallback: { reason: "pool_quota_exceeded", to: "dedicated-apac-1", cooldown: 0s }, re-eject: { reason: "latency_slo_miss", to: "dedicated-eu-1" } }
```
Samir: cooldown: 0s stands out. looks like our fallback policy allows immediate bounce back if latency changes a bit. that will cause ping-pong.
Mika: is this coming from the new quota-gating change we rolled yesterday? the one that evicts by tenant when pool usage > 92%?
Diego: yes, that config pushed at 02:15 UTC. it introduced aggressive ejection plus immediate re-probe. ticket 4621.
Amelia: impact: ~3.7k extra routed requests/min and spike in control-plane retries. several enterprise clients saw small tail-latency upticks. not yet customer-facing errors but noisy.
Samir: mitigation options: 1) set fallback cooldown to 30s 2) add hysteresis: require 2 consecutive overruns before ejection 3) temporary pin enterprise EU to pool-dedicated-eu-standby via console rollout 4) throttle reroute rate in router.
Mika: +1 to cooldown + hysteresis. easy hotfix: patch policy in central config store and hot-reload. I can push the change.
Diego: oncall-bot, start an incident with severity low-medium and add routing-policy tag?
Oncall-Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-289 — Routing policy thrash (low-medium). responders: @Diego, @Amelia, @Samir.
Amelia: I'll deploy a console rollout pin for the affected customers to standby pool so we stop oscillation while Samir/Mika push policy change.
Samir: pushing policy change now: changing ejection.cooldown = 30s and ejection.min_consecutive = 2. will monitor.
DeployBot: deploy pipeline started for config-service-v2 (canary -> 10% -> 100%).
Diego: monitoring: added a short-term dashboard with metric: routing.reroutes_per_min by tenant + cooling_count. alert if > 50/min for any single tenant.
Mika: policy change live on canary. initial metrics show reroutes dropping ~80% in the canary cohort.
Amelia: nice. once canary is healthy, roll global and then follow-up: add a console UX change to show "last fallback reason" and "cooldown remaining" per route — product ticket incoming.
Samir: agree. also need a test in our unit/integration suite that simulates quick oscillating latency to catch this. filing test task.
Diego: thanks all. keep updates here. I'll notify support for a heads-up to account managers for affected enterprise customers. :thumbsup:
Amelia: thanks — closing loop once global roll done and dashboard stable. :white_check_mark:
